stories.title: First winter weather threat in 265 days targets St. Louis as Thanksgiving travel ramps up
stories.summary: Drivers, Triple A and local road crews prepare for rain-and-snow mix ahead of the holiday rush.

stories.title: St. Louis renters face eviction amid legal battle, uncertain heat restoration at Benton Park complex
stories.summary: Benton Park families face freezing conditions in a tangled legal battle over their apartments as eviction notices threaten their Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Keeping veterans' graves from going bare at Jefferson Barracks this Christmas
stories.summary: A Colorado nonprofit says 145,000 headstones sat bare last Christmas. A Shrewsbury family is among those hoping donated wreaths will change that.

stories.title: Man sentenced for 1992 sexual assault of girl in St. Louis County after DNA cracks cold case
stories.summary: DNA linked Miguel Canizares to the sexual assaults of a 14-year-old and an adult woman, though the statute of limitations prevented prosecution for the latter case.

stories.title: 3 wounded, 4 teens in custody after shooting in north St. Louis County
stories.summary: Police said guns used in the incident were equipped with machine gun conversion devices, which allow guns to fire rounds more rapidly.

stories.title: Kim Gardner disbarred by Missouri Supreme Court
stories.summary: The state's top judges decided whether the former St. Louis circuit attorney could keep her license on Tuesday.

stories.title: Gov. Kehoe activates Missouri's emergency operations center ahead of planned Iowa lead detonation
stories.summary: Kehoe said the blast's effect on Missouri residents is expected to be minimal, but he wanted to ensure the state was prepared.

stories.title: Man receives 20-year sentence for 2020 murder in Mount Pleasant neighborhood
stories.summary: The St. Louis resident was sentenced for the shooting death of 29-year-old Samuel Reece back in September of 2020.

stories.title: St. Louis applies to be a host city for 2031 Women's World Cup
stories.summary: FIFA will choose 14 host cities in the U.S., four in Mexico, plus San José in Costa Rica and Kingston, Jamaica.

stories.title: St. Louis seeks prime contractor for $200M utility plant to replace airport's 1956 power system
stories.summary: The West Central Utility Plant and Electrical Substation is planned to be built on a six-acre site to the west of the airport's existing power substations.

stories.title: St. Louis police searching for endangered missing adult last seen near Maple Avenue
stories.summary: SLMPD put out an Endangered Missing Adult alert around 8 a.m. on Tuesday.

stories.title: Teen and adult sister killed in Midtown St. Louis shooting; 15-year-old injured
stories.summary: A 14-year-old boy and his 27-year-old sister died and a 15-year-old was critically injured in a shooting Sunday in Midtown. Police took a 17-year-old into custody.
